course.title: Coordinate Geometry and Differential Equations
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: Find the feet points of the S.D. on the line $\textstyle { \frac { x - 3 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 8 } { - 1 } } = { \frac { z - 3 } { 1 } } { \mathrm { ~ a n d ~ } } { \frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } } = { \frac { y + 7 } { 2 } } = { \frac { z - 6 } { 4 } } .$ Hence find the length and equation of the S.D.
